description.value: Woodman Chinese Food is a full-service Chinese restaurant in Chilliwack serving a broad menu of wok classics, dim sum, signature meat and seafood dishes, stir-fried noodles, fried rice, and bubble tea. The modernly decorated dining room is described as spacious with comfortable seating for all guests. Online ordering with pickup and local delivery is available, making it a convenient resupply point for cyclists passing through the Market Way corridor.
